goal: Read two sources and produce one short brief that a person can read. The sources are ../docs/security.md and ../docs/provider-contract.md, relative to this goal file. The brief is brief.html: one <section> for each source, with a short summary of what the source says.
done: brief.html exists, has a section for each source, and contains no TODO or TBD.

threads.name: orchestrator
threads.prompt: Plan the work. Give reader-1 the security source and reader-2 the provider contract. Each reader writes its notes to a file in its own folder, named in the task scope by its file name only. When both have reported, give reader-1 one task to write brief.html from both notes files. Its scope is brief.html and the two notes files, given by absolute path. Never name the artifacts folder in a scope; the runner collects brief.html itself. Then report.

threads.name: reader-1
threads.prompt: You read the source you are given and write short notes. When you write the brief, use only the notes you are given.

threads.name: reader-2
threads.prompt: You read the source you are given and write short notes.
